Held-note changes (2.77, ember at least 2.74) are the thinnest margin. The best of ten renders of two briefs over two rounds: the first round left every candidate outside ember on at least one column (short gaps 27.1-58.0 a minute, 2.46-2.64 held-note changes, holes of 30 %); round 2 asked the strings to sustain without a pause.
